text:
casey: hey @lee @sasha PTAL on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/492 — addressed the comments: moved batching logic into batch_util, renamed max_batch_size -> target_batch, added unit tests and a smoke script. PTAL when you have a sec. I think it's ready to schedule for canary but want one more approver.

lee: thanks — glanced, lgtm on the rename and tests. did you run the load-smoke? any perf regressions?

casey: ran load-smoke locally: no perf regressions on short sequences. command i used:
```
./scripts/load-smoke --target 100 --model small
```
Left a note in the PR about the perf numbers.

sasha: two tiny nits in PR thread (typo in comment, and one extra import). i'll push a commit in a minute. ptal after that.

casey: thanks! pushed the fix. also added a short e2e that covers cache warmup. cc @merge-ops — do you want this squashed before merge? it's mostly small fixes.

merge-ops: merge-ops: Please include the PR number in the release note. Squash preferred for cleanliness but not required. We can take it in the 9:00 canary slot today if it has 2 approvals and no blocking tests.

qa-bot: qa-bot: Flakiness check: this PR touched test_batcher; last 5 runs: 0 flaky failures. See pipeline: https://ci.redwood-inference.net/blue/organizations/jenkins/job/pr-492

lee: ok from me after sasha's last commit. @casey can you rebase main to pick up the CI fix? then i'll add the approval.

casey: rebased and force-pushed. should show green in ~5m. thanks all :thumbsup: 

sasha: approved. minor nit fixed earlier.

merge-ops: merge-ops: Scheduling 09:00 canary. I'll queue it once CI green and 2 approvals present. If anything blocks ping me here.

casey: awesome — marking PR as ready. cheers.
